■ Dedede Danger Dash Costicon
■ G-Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your light, fire or nature creatures.
Mach Fighter Triple Breaker
■ After this creature attacks, you may put the top 3 cards of your deck into your mana zone. If you do, you may put a creature from among them that costs less than the number of cards in your mana zone.
